subject: prd/plan-new
statement: If a plan/v2 task's execution demand is absent, partial, unknown, lacks a non-empty resolvable citation set, is inconsistent with deterministic derivation, is lowered below its assurance floor, contains any identifier forbidden by NFR-7, or has irrelevant, contradictory, or partially supporting evidence, then the system shall for structural, resolution, derivation, or portability defects, refuse checkpoint presentation; for semantic-support defects found by FR-30, refuse approval and return the whole plan to the checkpoint edit loop; in every case refuse freeze and projection and name every offending task, field, and rule
intent: a demand defect that identifies the task, invalid field or unsupported assessment value, expected semantic contract, and remedy
fit_criterion: one fixture per structural trigger produces zero checkpoint-ready artifact; one fixture per semantic-support trigger reaches the rubric but produces zero approval/freeze/projection; mixed valid/invalid task sets fail as a whole, and every defect carries task+field/value+rule+remedy
